name: lumina-backend
description: Stellar event indexer + GraphQL API for Lumina

scripts.build: node init && npm run build:graphql && npm run build:indexer
scripts.build:graphql: node init && cd graphql-server && npm run build
scripts.build:indexer: node init && cd indexer && npm run build
scripts.test: npm run test:indexer && npm run test:graphql
